pool.text: Northwest Normal University was founded in the city
Lanzhou University was founded during this year
Construction of the first steel truss bridge over the Yellow River
Lanzhou University of Technology was founded in the city
A large earthquake struck, killing many people in the region
Lanzhou was linked with Xi'an by a highway
Imperial Japanese bombers conducted a raid against civilian targets
Aircrews trained in live combat action for the upcoming war
The People's Liberation Army began the Battle of Lanzhou
The first railway to reach Lanzhou was finished
Baita Mountain Park was opened across Zhongshan Bridge
Plant 504 began construction as the first uranium enrichment plant
Gansu Agricultural University was founded in the city
Lanzhou City College was founded during this year
Lanzhou Jiaotong University was founded in the city
Xiguan Mosque was rebuilt during this year
The city was affected by the Sichuan earthquake
The World Health Organization reported on the city's air quality
Lanzhou New Area was approved by the State Council
A brucellosis outbreak affecting humans took place in the city
